CommunityApplications.Profile:
Dedicated game server containers for Unraid.
Four servers are maintained here, in three shapes. **ARK: Survival Ascended** and **V Rising** both ship Windows-only server binaries, so each is installed with SteamCMD from the Windows depot and run under GE-Proton. **RuneScape: Dragonwilds** sits in between: SteamCMD installs it, but from a native Linux depot, so it runs directly with no Proton. **Terraria** is the far end: a native Linux dedicated server with no SteamCMD or Proton involved at all.
The layout follows ich777's game server containers — the same `/serverdata/steamcmd` and `/serverdata/serverfiles` split, the same `UID`/`GID`/`VALIDATE` environment variables, and the same approach of downloading the game files on first boot so the image itself stays small.
Support is through GitHub issues: https://github.com/blckassassin/unraid-game-servers/issues
